title: QoS-HRGN Research HUD
runtime_scope: metadata read + graph/CNN inference + postprocess; excludes graph building and metrics

models.label: QoS-HRGN (graph + voxel)
models.desc: Typed hetero-graph + HGT + learned 0-2 hop mixture, projected to voxels and refined by a 3D CNN.

models.label: Graph only
models.desc: Same HGT graph model; node probabilities projected straight to voxels (no CNN refinement).

models.label: CNN refinement only
models.desc: Same refinement CNN without graph probability channels (MRI only).

models.label: GraphSAGE graph-only
models.desc: Ordinary GraphSAGE backbone instead of HGT, graph-only.

models.label: Fixed 2-hop graph-only
models.desc: HGT with a fixed shared 2-hop propagation instead of the learned hop mixture, graph-only.

models.label: SegResNet (MONAI)
models.desc: Independent strong 3D voxel baseline trained on the same split.

vs_full.ci_scope: conditional on this cohort, training protocol and fixed seed set

graph_only.ci_scope: conditional on this cohort, training protocol and fixed seed set

shapley.scope: Exact four-player feature-replacement Shapley of WT/TC/ET probabilities, fractional region-volume weighting

hop_scope: Node-majority regions, unweighted node histograms; additional propagation after HGT

qualitative.policy: Descriptive post-test examples selected by disclosed morphology/score rules, then random fill; not a representative performance sample

scope.scope: validation-only graph pilot; 64 train / 16 validation; no test subjects

notes.text: full/voxel stopped at the epoch cap (not early stopping): convergence is not demonstrated for this stage.
Single training seed - no seed-to-seed variance is available.
The SLIC resolution study is a short validation-set pilot, not a definitive optimum.
Full model vs SegResNet: mean-Dice difference is not distinguishable from zero (95% CI includes 0).
